source.title: Particle-in-cell Monte Carlo modeling of Langmuir probes in an Ar plasma

rights.source_notice: Copyright 2005 American Institute of Physics. No open redistribution license was identified.
rights.repository_scope: Derived numerical values and source metadata only. The source PDF and page image are not included.

current_sign.code_mapping: PICSimulation.avg_current equals electron-current magnitude minus ion-current magnitude
current_sign.do_not_use: PICSimulation.avg_conventional_current because it reverses the source sign

digitization.method: Trace the irregular solid experimental curve for the r_p/lambda_D=0.26 case. Record its ordinate at fixed 5 V intervals.

use_limits: Use these values for the negative-bias branch only.
Compare the CSV current with PICSimulation.avg_current, which keeps the source sign.
Do not treat the digitization uncertainty as the full experimental uncertainty.
The reported density and temperature came from the same probe characteristic.
Thus, this dataset is not an independent blind validation of those input parameters.
Do not use the second Figure 2 case until its density exponent is confirmed.
Do not add the source PDF or a page image to the repository.

known_source_issue.description: The second Figure 2 case prints 2.39e7 cm^-3 and r_p/lambda_D=0.49. The printed density gives 0.153. A density of 2.39e8 cm^-3 gives 0.485.
known_source_issue.effect: The present dataset includes only the internally consistent r_p/lambda_D=0.26 case.
